dom_rejection.source_claim: A contact at a source-literal location (extreme, shelf, ledge, LVN, minor node), not an A+ trade. Author takes at most one or two A+ trades per session.

absorption_reward_retest.source_claim: A contact at a real extreme. 27% of absorptions fail without the three-tick reward. Passes are the setups among those contacts.

stop_four_stage.source_claim: Three-tick replenishment is a minimum filter at a defended level. One or two ticks is the fake-out zone. Passes are the setups among source-literal contacts.

footprint_confirmed_reaction.source_claim: Footprint flag 3-4x at a valid level. Contacts are source-literal locations, not A+ trades.

vwap_deviation_fade.source_claim: Trades beyond the 1 band, ideally at 2, only with absorption. Contacts are VWAP-band touches, not A+ trades.

ofm_aggressive.source_claim: an A++ a handful of times a month. Short-gamma permission is not observable in Phase 1.5. The scan emits one unknown-with-reason per session, not per contact.

ofm_passive.source_claim: Squeeze fails with no aggression at the failure. Rarer than the aggressive OFM. Contacts at source-literal locations.

clean_squeeze.source_claim: A squeeze with no failure: fast, real aggression, no retest, no false start. At most one or two A+ trades per session among source-literal contacts.

balance_failure_fade.source_claim: Balance fade in long gamma about 80% of the time is a regime share, not a pass rate. Long-gamma permission is not observable in Phase 1.5. The scan emits one unknown-with-reason per session, not per contact.

defended_band_continuation.source_claim: A retest of an already-defended band. Contacts at source-literal locations, not A+ trades.

kg1_retest.source_claim: KG1 engine unpublished. Phase 1.5 has no supplied KG1 record, so the branch is empty.

microbalance_break.source_claim: P15-05 F3 microbalances. Qualifying breakouts, not every 1-minute bar.
